verdict.rationale: Cline's docs say users can bring their own API keys from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and others, run local models via Ollama or LM Studio, select models through the Cline provider, and set separate models for Plan and Act modes. A community user independently confirms using Gemini 2.5 rather than being limited to Anthropic. Another community report says Ollama support is uneven across models, which limits local-model quality but does not undercut multi-provider choice. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the per-session model-switching UI and a full list of supported providers.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose which underlying AI model powers my session from multiple providers

citations.quote: You can bring your own API keys from providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and others.
Run Cline with local models using Ollama, LM Studio or Atomic Chat.
select from available models directly in Cline
You can configure separate models for Plan and Act modes.
plus I can use Gemini 2.5 with it and am not limited to Anthropic only
